title: 22 December 1964: Rehearsal: Another Beatles Christmas Show
content:
This was the second day of rehearsals for Another Beatles Christmas Show, The Beatles’ 1964 festive variety performance, at London’s Hammersmith Odeon. The show opened on 24 December 1964.

In a break during this day’s rehearsals, Jimmy Savile and a BBC camera crew filmed a brief interview, lasting little more than a minute, for the Christmas Eve edition of Top Of The Pops. Savile was the presenter of the television programme, and also appeared in the stage show.

Page last updated: 24 April 2010

Also on this day...

  • 2010: Abbey Road’s zebra crossing given Grade II listed status
  • 2009: Paul McCartney live: O2 Arena, London
  • 1969: John Lennon and Yoko Ono give a press conference in Montreal
  • 1966: Mixing, editing: Strawberry Fields Forever
  • 1963: The Beatles live: Empire Theatre, Liverpool
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Star-Club, Hamburg
